name: Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne
decision_note: Corporate VC programme of Slovenská sporiteľňa (Erste Group) investing EUR 200k-1m in pre-seed/seed Slovak startups; led Vestberry's EUR 2.2m round in March 2025 and reports EUR 3.14m invested in seven startups by Q1 2026; co-invested with SIH in TrollWall AI (Apr 2026), Resitech (Jun 2025) and Eatster (Feb 2025).

evidence.quote: Hľadáme nádejné startupy, ktoré prinášajú nové produkty a služby zákazníkom, a to nielen v oblasti finančných služieb.
Na Slovensku vzniká prvý corporate venture capital program Seed Starter.
Investovať u nás chce 5 miliónov eur
3,14 milióna eur investoval Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne za 3 roky do siedmich
Bratislava-based company Vestberry has secured €2.2 million in a new funding round led by Seed Starter.

Venture to Future Fund s radosťou oznamuje, že v spolupráci so Seed Starterom Slovenskej sporiteľne uzavrel Series A investičné kolo vo výške 1 milión EUR s cieľom podpory globálneho rastu dynamického slovenského startupu Vestberry.
Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne získal 7 % podiel v slovenskom startupe SmartHead, ktorý poskytuje komplexné riešenia v oblasti udržateľnosti a ESG reportingu.
Na investícii sa podieľajú Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne, Slovak Investment Holding (SIH) a angel investor Miroslav Fedor.
Slovenský startup Resitech, ktorý výrazne zjednodušuje život vlastníkom bytov aj správcom, získava investíciu 500 000 eur od Seed Startera Slovenskej sporiteľne a Slovak Investment Holdingu (SIH).
Bratislava, 5. februára 2025 - Slovak Investment Holding (SIH) a Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne oznámili prvú spoločnú investíciu do slovenského startupu Eatster v celkovej hodnote 700 000 eur.

analyst_notes: Legal form: no ORSR entity named 'Seed Starter' was found (ORSR name search, 2026-10-25) and Startitup (2026-09-25) calls it Slovenská sporiteľňa's 'investičný program'; it is therefore recorded as a corporate VC programme of Slovenská sporiteľňa, a.s. (IČO 00151653, part of Erste Group), with the bank as the legal entity. Caplight's claim that it is a 100% subsidiary set up in Sept 2022 could not be confirmed. Not on the NBS fund-manager register (bank balance-sheet investing). Capital: EUR 5m announced for investing at launch (Startitup 2022-09-29, e7, headline); by Q1 2026 SLSP reports EUR 3.14m invested over 3 years in seven Slovak startups - Blockmate, SmartHead, Vestberry, Eatster, Resitech, IntellCRE and Pointee (e8, undated quarterly infographic; Startup Report Slovensko 2025 says 'viac ako 3 milióny eur'). Vestberry March 2025 round: AIN describes the lead 'Seed Starter' as a programme of Česká a Slovenská spořitelna; CzechCrunch says almost half of EUR 2.2m came from the Seed Starter of Česká and Slovenská spořitelna (joint Erste programme); the SLSP infographic counts Vestberry in its own portfolio, so the deal is attributed here; the Czech Seed Starter ČS is covered by the cz-vc pilot. Sector: the site says it seeks startups 'not only in financial services' (e5) - recorded as generalist with a fintech/banking-synergy preference (pilots with the bank). Startup Awards Slovensko 2026 offers the winner an investment of up to EUR 250k from Seed Starter (Startitup 2026-09-25). Aggregator-only items not used: TrollWall AI (Apr 2026, Caplight). Investment-period/IntellCRE dates not published by SLSP. Added by reviewer: co-investments with Slovak Investment Holding announced by SIH (co-investor press releases, class C for Seed Starter): TrollWall AI EUR 800k (9 Apr 2026), Resitech EUR 500k (16 Jun 2025), Eatster EUR 700k total, EUR 350k each (5 Feb 2025); round amounts are totals. Latest cited activity is now 2026-04-09.
